papers_found.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Pair Trading
papers_found.key_finding: LLM-parameterized high-level (pair selection) + low-level (execution) RL hierarchy; adapts via textual feedback without gradient training. Claims improvement over baselines but no specific Sharpe disclosed in abstract.
papers_found.hypothesis_connection: Pairs family exhausted (H152-H160). Interesting architecture for reference only.
papers_found.skip_reason: Pairs trading family closed as NOT CONFIRMED. No specific performance numbers to evaluate.

papers_found.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers_found.key_finding: PPO-LSTM with 'Filter-then-Rank' pair selection + 'Fixed Risk, Adaptive Mean' execution on Binance 1h crypto pairs. OOS significantly outperforms heuristic baseline (significant at 10% not 5%).
papers_found.hypothesis_connection: Crypto pairs on H264/H264b universe. Statistical significance marginal (10% not 5%).
papers_found.skip_reason: Crypto pairs only; statistical significance too marginal; pairs family closed.

papers_found.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers_found.key_finding: 138K+ earnings press releases 2005-2023. FinBERT has highest predictive power. Structural decomposition (section-level scoring) 'as informative as EPS surprise'. Prices fully reflect content at market open — OPG execution matches H174 setup. Accepted ACM ICAIF 2025.
papers_found.hypothesis_connection: H293 — directly upgrades H174 (OOS WR 81.8%). Section-weighted FinBERT score: 0.3*highlights + 0.2*results + 0.5*guidance.

papers_found.title: SAE-FiRE: Enhancing Earnings Surprise Predictions Through Sparse Autoencoder Feature Selection
papers_found.key_finding: Sparse Autoencoders + ANOVA F-tests for feature selection on financial documents reduces overfitting. No specific backtest Sharpe numbers in abstract.
papers_found.hypothesis_connection: Could improve FinBERT feature selection for H174/H293. Complex implementation.
papers_found.skip_reason: No quantitative results disclosed. Too complex to implement without benchmarks. Mark for future review after H293 is built.

papers_found.title: Deep Learning for Short-Term Equity Trend Forecasting: A Behavior-Driven Multi-Factor Approach
papers_found.key_finding: Dual-task MLP (joint regression + direction classification) with 40 behavioral factors (momentum herding, vol-price divergence, bottom reversals, TA). Superior IC/IR vs linear factor models. 5-day horizon.
papers_found.hypothesis_connection: H294 — extends H217 (alpha101 OOS Sharpe 1.559) with behavioral factors + dual-task loss. Gate: OOS Sharpe > 1.559.

papers_found.title: Time-Series Foundation Models (Chronos / TimesFM / Lag-Llama)
papers_found.key_finding: Zero-shot pretrained forecasting models from Amazon (Chronos), Google (TimesFM 200M), Morgan Stanley/Mila (Lag-Llama). No trading-specific Sharpe improvement documented yet.
papers_found.hypothesis_connection: Could replace GARCH vol estimator in H273 or HMM in H251. Wiki update only until backtested results emerge.
